skill.name: kling-3-0
skill.description: Run Kling 3.0 video generation through the RunComfy CLI. The skill helps select Standard, Pro, or 4K tiers for text-to-video and image-to-video jobs.
skill.summary: Generate Kling 3.0 videos with RunComfy text-to-video and image-to-video endpoints.
skill.author: runcomfy-com

security_audit.summary: The skill is Markdown documentation for using the RunComfy CLI, not executable Ruby code. Most static hits are false positives from Markdown backticks, but the skill intentionally asks agents to run external RunComfy commands, use tokens, contact RunComfy APIs, and download generated media.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution and global package installation
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before installing @runcomfy/cli or running any runcomfy command. Show the exact command, endpoint, duration, output directory, and estimated cost before execution.
Tell users that RunComfy tokens are required and should be stored only through the official CLI or a protected RUNCOMFY_TOKEN secret. Never echo tokens in prompts, logs, or reports.

remediation.issue: Third-party transfer of prompts and image URLs
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before submitting confidential prompts, customer assets, or private image URLs to the RunComfy service. Prefer public, approved assets for image-to-video jobs.
Require an explicit output directory and keep the documented file size limit. Avoid writing generated files into sensitive project directories by default.

content.value_statement: Teams need clear controls for Kling 3.0 video generation across quality tiers. This skill helps choose the right RunComfy endpoint and prepare text-to-video or image-to-video requests.
actual_capabilities: Selects Standard, Pro, or 4K Kling 3.0 tiers based on output needs.
Supports text-to-video and image-to-video RunComfy endpoint selection.
Explains key inputs such as prompt, duration, aspect ratio, seed, and audio.
Provides RunComfy CLI invocation patterns for all six Kling 3.0 endpoints.
Offers prompting guidance for motion, camera language, identity anchors, and multi-shot clips.
Documents pricing considerations, duration limits, output handling, and exit codes.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and an authenticated RunComfy account or token.
Image-to-video jobs require publicly fetchable HTTPS image URLs.
Each Kling 3.0 generation is limited to 15 seconds.
4K and audio generations can increase cost and produce large files.

use_cases.title: Create Social Video Drafts
use_cases.description: Generate short Standard-tier previews for social concepts before spending budget on higher-fidelity renders.

use_cases.title: Animate Brand Assets
use_cases.description: Turn approved product images or character art into controlled image-to-video clips with identity anchors.

use_cases.title: Prepare 4K Hero Clips
use_cases.description: Plan high-resolution RunComfy jobs for finished cinematic clips with native 4K output and optional audio.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 5 second Kling 3.0 Standard text-to-video draft for a calm product reveal in 16:9.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Kling 3.0 image-to-video to animate this approved HTTPS image. Preserve the subject, add gentle camera motion, and keep the clip under 8 seconds.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Quality Tiers
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend the best Kling 3.0 tier for a 10 second hero clip with audio, realistic motion, and final 1080p delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Shot Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Kling 3.0 Pro prompt for three connected shots with consistent character identity, camera directions, ambient sound, and a controlled ending.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a low-cost vertical cafe video for social testing.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Standard text-to-video, 9:16 aspect ratio, a 5 second duration, and a concise motion-focused prompt.

output_examples.input: A user provides a product image URL and wants a polished launch clip.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Pro image-to-video, identity preservation language, optional audio, and an explicit output directory.

output_examples.input: A user needs a finished cinematic master for a large display.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends the 4K endpoint, warns about cost and file size, and suggests testing composition at Standard first.

best_practices: Confirm the RunComfy command, endpoint, cost estimate, and output directory before running the CLI.
Use Standard tier for drafts, then move approved prompts to Pro or 4K.
Use approved public image URLs and avoid confidential assets unless sharing is intended.
anti_patterns: Do not run global npm installation or RunComfy login without clear user consent.
Do not submit private prompts, faces, or customer assets without approval.
Do not start 4K or audio jobs before validating duration, aspect ratio, and budget.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It helps generate Kling 3.0 videos through RunComfy text-to-video and image-to-video endpoints.

faq.question: Does it require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI needs login or a RUNCOMFY_TOKEN before jobs can run.

faq.question: Which quality tiers are covered?
faq.answer: The skill covers Standard, Pro, and 4K tiers for both text-to-video and image-to-video.

faq.question: Can it use a local image file?
faq.answer: No. Image-to-video requires a publicly fetchable HTTPS image URL.

faq.question: What is the maximum clip length?
faq.answer: Each Kling 3.0 generation is limited to 15 seconds.

faq.question: What should users confirm before running it?
faq.answer: Users should confirm the command, endpoint, token use, estimated cost, source assets, and output directory.
